metaTitle: Custom Multi Color Socks | Perfect Imprints
metaDescription: Order custom multi color socks in bulk for your team or event. Perfect for branding with your logo. Get a quote today!
introHtml: Multi color socks let you combine two or more brand colors into a single accessory, creating a look that stands out more than a single solid shade. Whether you are outfitting a sales team for a trade show or adding personality to employee uniforms, these socks work well with screen printing or woven labels. Choose contrasting stripes or a subtle two-tone pattern to match your logo exactly.
heroAltText: Custom multi color socks with team logo in contrasting stripes for corporate giveaways
